Campaign.title: Campaign
Campaign.description: Public real-time community counter for Dasam Baby Venkatesh.

title.description: Display title of the campaign in Telugu.

supportersCount.description: Total real-time count of unique community member devices.

lastDeviceId.description: Deterministic device fingerprint ID (fp_<hash>) or legacy device ID of the most recent atomic join.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the campaign document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest community join.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: Per-device membership record enforcing one join per device.

deviceId.description: Unique sanitized deterministic device fingerprint (fp_<hash>) or legacy device ID matching the document ID.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when this device joined the community.

/campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Stores the real-time community member count for the Dasam Baby Venkatesh campaign.

/campaigns/{campaignId}/members/{deviceI.description: Tracks each device that has joined the community to enforce single join per device.
